_meta.description: Cosmere 5e Surgebinding mechanics, extracted from the Radiant's Handbook (plan 2.9). Tier 2 in the three-tier rules architecture (plan D1/§8): these entries ADJUDICATE. Tier 1 is SRD JSON; Tier 3 is Qdrant lore, which never adjudicates.
_meta.extraction_note: Every entry carries source.line pointing at parsed_data/863203275-cosmere-5e-radiant-s-handbook-v2-0/docling.md and reviewed:true only when the mechanics were read verbatim from that text. Unreviewed entries MUST NOT adjudicate (plan D5).
_meta.correction: An earlier hardcoded implementation in components/combat/roshar_actions.py invented a per-use Stormlight-sphere cost for every surge. The Handbook actually uses an expendable DICE economy (Lashing Dice for Windrunners, Investiture Points for Invested Arts) recovered on rest. Those numbers were plausible and wrong; these are quoted.
_meta.surges_note: All ten surge cantrips are named and cited: each order's 'You know two cantrips, X and Y' line is verbatim in the source. Their MECHANICAL EFFECTS are not — the Handbook defers them to a separate document ('See The Invested Arts of the Cosmere for detailed information about these cantrips', stated seven times, e.g. lines 1808/3630/4428/4904/5375/5934/6580), and line 279 confirms 'the detailed descriptions of each Invested Art are found in a separate document'. That document is NOT in resources/. So `automation` is null with automation_status 'not_in_source' rather than invented: per D5 and _meta.extraction_note an unreviewed entry MUST NOT adjudicate, and _meta.correction records that a previous hardcoded implementation invented Stormlight costs that were 'plausible and wrong'. A null tree makes a surge cast fall through to the rules judge as a Tier-3 ruling, which is the correct outcome for a rule we do not have. To make one playable, obtain the Invested Arts document and author the tree.

lashing_dice.name: Lashing Dice
lashing_dice.recovery: all expended dice on a short or long rest
lashing_dice.notes: Fuels Maneuvers, including ones using Adhesion or general Investiture intake rather than actual Lashings. Dice count and size both increase with level per the Windrunner table.
lashing_dice.quote: You have two Lashing dice to fuel your Maneuvers (even ones that use Adhesion or just the general intake of Investiture, rather than actual Lashings), which are d4s, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the Lashing Dice column of the Windrunner table. The dice also increase in size as you gain Windrunner levels, as shown in the Lashing Die Size column of the Windrunner table. A Lashing die is expended when you use it. You regain all of your expended Lashing dice when you finish a short or long rest.

investiture_points.name: Investiture Points
investiture_points.recovery: on a long rest, requires intaking Stormlight
investiture_points.special: Elsecallers always spend only 1 Investiture Point regardless of Art level.
investiture_points.quote: To cast an Invested Art of level 1 or higher, you must expend a certain number of Investiture points. Cantrips don't cost any Investiture point to cast.

stormlight_replenishment.name: Stormlight Replenishment
stormlight_replenishment.long_rest_requirement: level x 5 sapphire marks' worth of Stormlight
stormlight_replenishment.consequence_if_unmet: does not recover hit points or regain expended class features
stormlight_replenishment.quote: You must intake a certain amount of Investiture at the end of each long rest in order to recover hit points and regain expended class features. The amount is your level x 5 of sapphire marks' worth of Stormlight.

invested_save_dc.quote: Invested save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Investiture ability modifier

Skybreaker.notes: Does not gain the Surge of Division until 5th level.

Edgedancer.quote: You have sworn the First Ideal of the Order of Edgedancers of the Knights Radiant with your cultivationspren. Your spren has provided you with the Surges of Abrasion and Progression. These Surges power your Investiture. You must intake a certain amount of Investiture at the end of each long rest in order to recover hit points and regain expended class features. The amount is your level x 5 of sapp

Truthwatcher.quote: You have sworn the First Ideal of the Order of Truthwatchers of the Knights Radiant with your mistspren. Your spren has provided you with the Surges of Progression and Illumination. These Surges power your Investiture. You must intake a certain amount of Investiture at the end of each long rest in order to recover hit points and regain expended class features. The amount is your level x 5 of sapph

Lightweaver.quote: You have sworn the First Ideal of the Order of Lightweavers of the Knights Radiant with your Cryptic. Your spren has provided you with the Surges of Illumination and Transformation. These Surges power your Investiture. You must intake a certain amount of Investiture at the end of each long rest in order to recover hit points and regain expended class features. The amount is your level x 5 of sapph

Elsecaller.special: always spends 1 Investiture Point per Art

Dustbringer.notes: Does not gain the Surge of Division until 5th level.
Dustbringer.quote: You have sworn the First Ideal of the Order of Dustbringers of the Knights Radiant with your ashspren. Your spren has provided you with the Surge of Abrasion. You do not gain access to the Surge of Division until 5th level. Abrasion, and soon Division, powers your Investiture. You must intake a certain amount of Investiture at the end of each long rest in order to recover hit points and regain exp

Willshaper.quote: You have sworn the First Ideal of the Order of Willshapers of the Knights Radiant with your Reacher. Your spren has provided you with the Surges of Transportation and Cohesion. These Surges power your Investiture. You must intake a certain amount of Investiture at the end of each long rest in order to recover hit points and regain expended class features. The amount is your level x 5 of sapphire m

Stoneward.quote: You have sworn the First Ideal of the Order of Stonewards of the Knights Radiant with your peakspren. Your spren has provided you with the Surges of Cohesion and Tension. These Surges power your Investiture. You must intake a certain amount of Investiture at the end of each long rest in order to recover hit points and regain expended class features. The amount is your level x 5 of sapphire marks'

Bondsmith.notes: Not a playable class in the Radiant's Handbook: 'there is an optional class description for them found in Hoid's Guide to the Cosmere'. Nine orders are playable, not ten.
Bondsmith.quote: Nine classes-listed in the table in the next section-are found in Roshar as the Knights Radiant are formed once again to protect the people of the land. As there are only ever a few Bondsmiths at a time and they can be quite a bit more powerful than other Radiants, there is an optional class description for them found in Hoid's Guide to the Cosmere .

maneuvers.name: Full Lashing

fail.name: Restrained
fail.duration: until start of your next turn

maneuvers.quote: As an action you can expend a Lashing die and attempt to restrain a creature you can see within 30 feet with a Full Lashing. That creature must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is restrained until the beginning of your next turn. Additionally, on a failed save, roll the expended Lashing die and the creature takes that amount of bludgeoning damage.

maneuvers.name: Reverse Lashing
maneuvers.trigger: a creature you can see within 30 feet is hit by a weapon attack
maneuvers.quote: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is hit by a weapon attack, you can use your reaction and expend a Lashing die to attempt to draw away the weapon before the damage is rolled. That creature gains a bonus to their AC equal to the number rolled for the triggering attack.

maneuvers.name: Distracting Attack

automation.name: Distracted
automation.duration: until the start of your next turn

maneuvers.quote: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one Lashing die to distract the creature ... The next attack roll against the target by an attacker other than you has advantage.

maneuvers.name: Goading Attack

fail.name: Goaded
fail.duration: until the end of your next turn

maneuvers.quote: you can expend one Lashing die to attempt to goad the target into attacking you ... On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on all attack rolls against targets other than you until the end of your next turn.

maneuvers.name: Evasive Movement
maneuvers.quote: When you move, you can expend one Lashing die, rolling it and adding the number rolled to your AC until you stop moving.

maneuvers.name: Riposte
maneuvers.trigger: a creature misses you with a melee weapon attack
maneuvers.quote: When a creature misses you with a melee weapon attack, you can use your reaction and expend one Lashing die to make a melee weapon attack against the creature.

maneuvers.name: Alerted Lash
maneuvers.quote: When you or a willing creature you can see within 30 feet rolls initiative and not surprised, you can expend a Lashing die and add the number rolled to your initiative check.

maneuvers.name: Athletic Lashings
maneuvers.quote: When you make a Strength (Athletics) check, you can expend a Lashing die, rolling the die and adding it to the d20 roll.

maneuvers.name: Acrobatic Lashings
maneuvers.quote: When you make a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, you can expend a Lashing die, rolling the die and adding it to the d20 roll.

maneuvers.name: Feinting Attack

effects.name: Feinting
effects.duration: until the end of your turn

maneuvers.quote: You can expend one Lashing die and use a bonus action on your turn to feint, choosing one creature within 5 feet of you as your target. You have advantage on your next attack roll against that creature this turn. If that attack hits, add the Lashing die to the attack's damage roll.

maneuvers.name: Flourish
maneuvers.quote: When you make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, you can expend a Lashing die, rolling the die and adding it to the d20 roll. You can wait until after rolling the d20 before using this maneuver but must do so before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

maneuvers.name: Invested Focus
maneuvers.quote: When you make a Knowledge check, you can expend a Lashing die, rolling the die and adding it to the d20 roll. You can wait until after rolling the d20 before using this maneuver but must do so before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

maneuvers.name: Invested Perception
maneuvers.quote: When you make a Dexterity (Perception) check, you can expend a Lashing die, rolling the die and adding it to the d20 roll. You can wait until after rolling the d20 before using this maneuver but must do so before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

maneuvers.name: Lash Ally

effects.name: Lash Ally
effects.duration: until the beginning of their next turn

maneuvers.quote: You can use your bonus action and expend one Lashing die to move one of your allies into a more advantageous position. Choose a willing creature within 60 feet of you that you can see and roll the Lashing die. You can move the creature in one direction up to 30 feet. This movement does not draw opportunity attacks, and the creature gains a bonus to their AC equal to the number rolled until the beginning of their next turn.

maneuvers.name: Lash Enemy

effects.direction: in a straight line away from you

maneuvers.quote: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one Lashing die to attempt to Lash the target back. You add the Lashing die to the attack's damage roll, and if the target is Large or smaller, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, you Lash the target and move them in a straight line up to 15 feet away. This movement does not draw opportunity attacks..

maneuvers.name: Lunging Strike
maneuvers.quote: When you make a melee weapon attack on your turn, you can expend one Lashing die to increase your reach for that attack by 5 feet. If you hit, you add the Lashing die to the attack's damage roll.

maneuvers.name: Parry
maneuvers.trigger: another creature damages you with a melee attack

effects.damage_reduction: the number you roll on your Lashing die plus your Dexterity modifier

maneuvers.quote: When another creature damages you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction and expend one Lashing die to reduce the damage by the number you roll on your Lashing die + your Dexterity modifier.

maneuvers.name: Precision Attack
maneuvers.quote: When you make a weapon attack roll against a creature, you can expend one Lashing die and add it to the roll. You can use this maneuver before or after making the attack roll, but before any effects of the attack are applied and before the GM says whether the attack hits or not.

maneuvers.name: Quiet Lashing
maneuvers.quote: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check, you can expend a Lashing die, rolling the die and adding it to the d20 roll. You can wait until after rolling the d20 before using this maneuver but must do so before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

maneuvers.name: Rally

effects.temporary_hit_points: the Lashing die roll plus your Charisma modifier

maneuvers.quote: You can use a bonus action and expend one Lashing die to bolster the resolve of one of your companions. When you do so, choose a friendly creature you can see within 60 feet of you that you can see. That creature gains temporary hit points equal to the Lashing die roll + your Charisma modifier.

maneuvers.name: Rampage
maneuvers.trigger: you reduce a creature to 0 hit points

effects.follow_up_attack: one melee weapon attack, adding the Lashing die roll to the attack roll, if you end this movement within 5 feet of a creature

maneuvers.quote: When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you can use your bonus action to expend a Lashing die and move up to half your speed. If you end this movement within 5 feet of a creature, you can make a single melee weapon attack against that creature, adding the result of the Lashing die roll to the attack roll.

maneuvers.name: Rescuing Wind

effects.name: Rescuing Wind

effects.ac_bonus_recipient: you or the other creature (your choice)

effects.duration: until the start of your next turn

maneuvers.quote: When you're within 5 feet of a creature on your turn, you can use a bonus action and expend one Lashing die to switch places with that creature, provided you spend at least 5 feet of movement and the creature is willing and isn't incapacitated. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. Roll the Lashing die. Until the start of your next turn, you or the other creature (your choice) gains a bonus to AC equal to the number rolled.

maneuvers.name: Saving Lash
maneuvers.trigger: an ally you can see within 60 feet makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw
maneuvers.quote: When an ally that you can see within 60 feet makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, you can use your reaction and expend a Lashing die to add the number rolled to the result of that saving throw. You can wait until after the d20 roll before using this maneuver but must do so before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

maneuvers.name: Slowing Lash

automation.name: Slowed

effects.speed_reduction: the Lashing die roll multiplied by 2, rounded up to the nearest 5 feet

automation.duration: until the end of their turn

maneuvers.quote: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one Lashing die to attempt to slow the creature. Roll the Lashing die and multiply the result by 2, then round up to the nearest 5 feet. The creature loses that much speed until the end of their turn.

maneuvers.name: Thrown Lashing
maneuvers.quote: As a bonus action, you can expend one Lashing die and make a ranged attack with a weapon that has the thrown property. You can draw the weapon as part of making this attack. If you hit, add the Lashing die to the weapon's damage roll.

maneuvers.name: Tripping Lash
maneuvers.quote: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one Lashing die to attempt to knock the target down. You add the Lashing die to the attack's damage roll, and if the target is Large or smaller, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, you knock the target prone.

features.name: Windrun

effect.restriction: cannot carry another creature or anything above normal equipment

features.quote: As a bonus action, you give yourself a flying speed equal to your normal walking speed + 10 feet, as well as the ability to hover, for 10 minutes.

features.name: Second Ideal — Stormlight Surge
features.trigger: swearing a new Ideal during gameplay with words approved by the GM

effect.heal_per_turn: {proficiency_bonus}d6 at the start of each of your turns
effect.flight: can Windrun with no uses left, +10 flying speed
effect.advantage: attack rolls are made with advantage
effect.free_maneuver: once per turn use a known Maneuver without expending a Lashing die

features.quote: If you swear one of these new Ideals during regular gameplay and your words are approved, you glow with Stormlight and are able to use your Windrunner abilities much more easily for 1 minute.

features.name: Skyward

effect.restriction: cannot carry another creature or anything above normal equipment

scaling.6: flying speed walking_speed + 10; can carry willing companions (Skyward travel)

features.quote: As a bonus action, you give yourself a flying speed equal to your normal walking speed, as well as the ability to hover, for 10 minutes. While flying, you cannot carry another creature or anything above your normal equipment.

features.name: Stormlight Healing

effect.heal: up to the amount remaining in the reserve
effect.condition_removal: at 5th level, expend 25 points to remove the poisoned or diseased condition

features.quote: You keep a reserve of Investiture in you to be used for healing yourself that replenishes when you take a long rest. The reserve holds a number of hit points equal to your Skybreaker level x 5. As an action, you can use the Investiture to heal yourself, up to the maximum amount remaining in your reserve. Once you are 5th level, you can also use this feature to instead remove the poisoned or diseased condition from you, expending 25 points of Stormlight Healing to do so.

features.name: Infused Skin

effect.condition: not wearing armor and no shield equipped

features.quote: Your Surge of Abrasion makes you extremely elusive. Your AC when you are not wearing armor and have no shield equipped equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Infused Hands

effect.finesse: use Dexterity instead of Strength for attack and damage rolls of unarmed strikes and proficient weapons
effect.infused_die: roll a d4 in place of normal damage; the die increases with Dustbringer level per the Infused Die column
effect.condition: unarmed or using a proficient weapon, not wearing armor or wielding a shield

features.quote: You coat your hands and arms almost constantly with Abrasion, giving you quickness in combat. You gain the following benefits when unarmed or using a proficient weapon, and you aren't wearing armor or wielding a shield: You can use Dexterity instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of your unarmed strikes and proficient weapons. You can roll a d4 in place of the normal damage of your unarmed strike or proficient weapon. This die changes as you gain Dustbringer levels, as shown in the Infused Die column of the Dustbringer table.

features.name: Edgedance

effect.form_hit_points: a separate pool representing your ability to remain in the form
effect.revert: as a bonus action, or automatically at 0 hit points, unconscious, death, or when the form's hit points are lost
effect.casting_limit: while in Edgedance you can only cast cantrips (higher-level Invested Arts unlock per the Form Inv. Level column)

features.quote: You can use your action to enter a form of Edgedance, a form in which you completely enshroud yourself in a combination of your Surges to amplify your abilities. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. You regain expended uses when you finish a short or long rest. You gain the ability to use this an unlimited number of times at 20th level (see 'Limitless Dancer').

features.name: Truth Dice
features.uses_per_rest: proficiency bonus + Investiture ability modifier (INT, WIS, or CHA; minimum 1)

effect.grant: one Truth die (a d4; increases with level per the Truth Die Size column) to a creature you can see other than yourself
effect.use: within 10 minutes the creature adds the die to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw
effect.limit: a creature can only have one Truth die at a time, including from other Truthwatchers

features.quote: You can utilize your Progression and Illumination to aid your allies Physically and Cognitively. To do so, you use a bonus action on your turn to choose one creature you can see, other than yourself, within 60 feet of you. That creature gains one Truth die, a d4. The size of your Truth dice change when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Truth Die Size column of the Truthwatcher table.

features.name: Illusory Elusion
features.quote: Your constant, subtle Lightweavings, making it difficult to see exactly where your body and limbs are, give you a slight edge in battle when you are attacked. Your normal AC equals 11 + your Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Stormlight Healing

effect.heal: roll d6s equal to your current Invested Art level and heal that total plus your Intelligence modifier

features.quote: As an action, you can expend an Investiture point to heal yourself using Investiture. Roll a number of d6s equal to your current Invested Art level, as shown on the Elsecaller table, and heal yourself the result plus your Intelligence modifier.

features.name: Willshape

effect.ends: become visible if you take damage, attack, deal damage, or force a creature to make a saving throw
effect.extend: expend another use at the end of the duration to extend it

scaling.10: Willshape as a bonus action; visibility triggers only at end of your turn; up to 1 hour

features.quote: At 2nd level, you can now use your action to Willshape and become invisible, using Transportation to partially Elsecall yourself. You become immediately visible if you take damage, or if you attack, deal damage, or force a creature to make a saving throw. You can remain invisible this way for up to 10 minutes, though you can expend another use of the feature at the end of the duration to extend it.

features.name: Ward
features.uses_per_rest: per the Wards column of the Stoneward table

effect.advantage: Strength ability checks and Strength saving throws
effect.bonus_damage: extra die (d4; increases per the Ward Damage column) of your weapon's damage type on a Strength melee hit; doubled on a critical hit
effect.resistance: non-Invested bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage
effect.restriction: cannot enter while wearing heavy armor; cannot cast or concentrate on Invested Arts while in your Ward

features.quote: In battle, you utilize your two Surges to both strengthen your defense and weaken the defense of your foes. On your turn, you can enter your Ward as a bonus action if you aren't wearing heavy armor. While in your Ward, you gain the following benefits: You have advantage on Strength ability checks and Strength saving throws. When you hit with a melee weapon attack using Strength, you can roll an extra die for bonus damage. This damage is the same type as your weapon's damage. It is a d4, and it increases as you gain Stoneward levels, as shown in the Ward Damage column of the Stoneward table. This die is doubled on critical hits like normal. You have resistance to non-Invested bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

Adhesion.name: Adhesion
Adhesion.description: Bind objects or creatures together with spren pressure.
Adhesion.quote: This Invested Art is a minor Full Lashing Surge. You create one of the following effects:

effects.name: Stabilized
effects.description: Spiritual Adhesion stabilizes a creature at 0 hit points; no effect on splinters or entities.

effects.narration: A 5-by-5-foot unoccupied space becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute to any creature moving through it.

options.label: Stick a Tiny object to a surface

effects.narration: A Tiny, non-Invested, non-aluminum object weighing 5 pounds or less is stuck for up to 1 minute; a creature frees it with a Strength (Athletics) check, DC 8 + your proficiency bonus (9 at 5th, 10 at 11th, 11 at 17th level).

Adhesion.adjudication_reason: Choose-one cantrip authored with a choice node. Stabilize is a real mechanic (ieffect2 Stabilized); difficult terrain and the stuck object resolve as utility effects, with the book's scaling escape DC recorded verbatim in the narration.

Gravitation.name: Gravitation
Gravitation.description: Change the direction gravity pulls on a target.
Gravitation.quote: This Invested Art is a minor Basic Lashing Surge. You can use Lashings to do one of the following:

effects.narration: You Lash a Tiny (Small at 5th, Medium at 11th, Large at 17th level) non-Invested, non-aluminum object in a direction you choose; it travels 10 feet per round, too slow to deal damage.
You slow a falling creature's descent to 60 feet per round; it takes no damage from the fall.

Gravitation.adjudication_reason: Choose-one cantrip. The 11th-level creature-Lash is a real attack roll that forces movement on a hit (attack + forced_move, 20 ft, 30 ft at 17th); object-Lash and slow-fall resolve as utility. NOTE: the attack node uses the caster's weapon attack roll; the book specifies an Investiture-ability attack roll, so a dedicated Investiture-attack node would be the precise refinement.

Division.name: Division
Division.quote: This Invested Art is a minor Division Surge. You can use your action to kindle a fire, lighting a torch, kindling, or something else with abundant, exposed fuel. Instead, you can create one of the following effects using your bonus action:

effects.narration: You kindle a fire, lighting a torch, kindling, or something else with abundant, exposed fuel.
You touch the corpse of a creature and slowly decay the spot you touch.
You touch a Tiny plant and infuse it with Division, decaying it over the next minute.
You decay or burn a small mark into a non-living object.

Division.adjudication_reason: All four Division cantrip effects are pure utility (kindle fire, decay a corpse spot, decay a Tiny plant, burn a mark); each resolves as a narrated utility effect. The cantrip has no combat mechanic (the damaging leveled Division Arts are a separate tier).

Abrasion.name: Abrasion
Abrasion.description: Reduce or increase friction on a surface or creature.
Abrasion.quote: This Invested Art is a minor Abrasion Surge. You create one of the following effects within range:

effects.narration: An unattended small object becomes slippery for up to 1 minute; a creature grabs it with a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, DC 8 + your proficiency bonus.

You infuse your feet and slide in a straight line half your movement speed (rounded down to the nearest 5 feet). If your path is obstructed or difficult terrain, make a DC 14 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or fall prone and stop.

Abrasion.adjudication_reason: Two effects, both resolvable as utility: the slippery object records the grab DC (8 + proficiency); the slide records the movement and the DC 14 obstruction check. The obstruction check is conditional on terrain the fixed two-row grid cannot represent, so it is narrated rather than auto-rolled (auto-rolling would misplay a clean slide as sometimes falling prone).

Progression.name: Progression
Progression.quote: This Invested Art is a minor Regrowth or Growth Surge. You create one of the following effect within range:

effects.name: Stabilized
effects.description: Stabilize one creature at 0 HP (no effect on splinters/entities)

Progression.adjudication_reason: Stabilize effect is fully modeled. Second effect (make tiny plant grow instantly) is pure flavor with no mechanics.

Illumination.name: Illumination
Illumination.description: Weave light and sound into illusion.
Illumination.quote: This Invested Art is a minor Lightweaving Surge. You create one of the following effects within range:

effects.narration: You Lightweave a harmless sensory effect within 30 feet for up to 1 minute: a small illusion, a faint sound, or a small light (5 feet of dim and 5 feet of bright light).
You Lightweave a creature's eyes to change color for 1 minute; the target immediately knows it is being cast on them.
You Lightweave a color, small mark, or glyph on an object or surface for 1 hour.

You Lightweave a different voice on yourself or a touched creature for 1 hour. To mimic a known voice, a listener who knows it may make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your Invested save DC to notice it is false.

Illumination.adjudication_reason: The four cantrip effects are minor sensory illusions with no combat mechanic; each resolves as a utility effect (voice-change records the Investigation-contest DC). Full illusion-with-disbelief and the 'up to three active at once' bookkeeping are a Lightweaving subsystem not built here, but the cantrip itself is resolvable.

Transformation.name: Transformation
Transformation.description: Persuade a substance to become another — Soulcasting.
Transformation.quote: This Invested Art is a minor Soulcasting Surge. You create one of the following effects within range:

effects.narration: You instantly Soulcast a small object no larger than 1 cubic foot to clean or soil it.
You chill or warm up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour.
You cause flames within range to flicker, brighten, or dim.
While in the Cognitive Realm, you touch a bead to know its item and, fed roughly 1 sapphire mark of Stormlight per cubic foot, manifest it as the Physical object for 1 minute per mark spent.

Transformation.adjudication_reason: The three physical effects resolve as utility; the Cognitive-Realm bead manifestation resolves as utility but its Stormlight-fed duration tracking needs a Realm/resource subsystem not built here. The cantrip has no combat mechanic (the CON-save-based 5th-level Soulcast Art is a separate tier).

Transportation.name: Transportation
Transportation.quote: This Invested Art is a minor Elsecalling Surge. When you use it, you can see partially into the Cognitive Realm (or the Physical Realm if you're already in the Cognitive Realm) to see around you in a 10-foot radius.

automation.narration: You see partially into the Cognitive Realm (or the Physical Realm, if already in the Cognitive) in a 10-foot radius — the ground and basic surroundings only, very hazily. You cannot see creatures, plants, splinters, or Investiture.

Transportation.adjudication_reason: Single-effect cantrip: cross-realm vision in a 10-foot radius. It resolves as a utility effect (the DM narrates what is glimpsed). No combat mechanic; full Realm travel is a separate subsystem.

Cohesion.name: Cohesion
Cohesion.description: Soften, mold and reshape stone and crystal.
Cohesion.quote: This Invested Art is a minor Surge of Strong Axial Interconnection. Using your bonus action, you can create one of the following effects on non-Invested stone or rock that you can touch:

effects.narration: You form a Tiny or smaller chunk of non-Invested stone into a different shape (larger stone takes more time: 1 action for Small, 1 minute for Medium, 10 minutes for Large; the GM may require an Investiture ability check or Stormlight).
You cause imprints to appear on stone — glyphs, words, images, or patterns — that last 10 minutes, then revert.
You make a 5-foot square of ground stone become difficult terrain, or make difficult stone become normal terrain, for 1 minute, then it reverts.

Cohesion.adjudication_reason: Stone-shaping and imprints resolve as utility. The 5-foot difficult-terrain toggle is a real mechanic, but the fixed two-row grid has no per-square terrain to flip, so it resolves as a narrated utility effect rather than an invented grid change.

Tension.name: Tension
Tension.description: Make the flexible rigid, or the rigid flexible.
Tension.quote: This Invested Art is a minor Surge of Soft Axial Interconnection. You create one of the following effects on a non-Invested object or piece of clothing you can touch:

options.label: Stiffen a creature's clothing (+2 AC, -10 ft)
Stiffen fabric into a small shield (+1 AC)
Stiffen an object into a 1d6 weapon

effects.narration: You stiffen an object for up to 1 minute into an improvised weapon that deals 1d6 non-Invested bludgeoning damage; a wielder proficient with a similar weapon may add their proficiency bonus (GM's call).

Tension.adjudication_reason: Choose-one cantrip. Stiffen-clothing (+2 AC, -10 ft speed; target must not be wearing armor, no stacking) and improvised-shield (+1 AC) are real mechanics recorded as ieffect2 inline effects for the session to apply; the 1d6 improvised weapon resolves as utility (it creates an object the wielder later attacks with).
